title: Aislamiento tenant — aplicación, servicios y API
findings: The new tenant-aware scope resolves authority from an active UsuarioEmpresa membership and validates the current Usuario, Empresa and Rol server-side.
EmpresaId supplied by the client is treated only as a requested tenant selection; it does not grant authority and returns fail-closed when membership or related state is invalid.
The new tenant-aware path derives RolId and administrator semantics from UsuarioEmpresa.RolId, not Usuario.RolId.

Cross-tenant membership absence, inactive membership, inactive company, blocked/inactive user or inactive role converge on the same null result; the API returns Forbid without disclosing resource existence.

The legacy no-argument UsuarioScopeActual method is retained only for backward compatibility and is explicitly documented as non-authoritative for tenant-owned resources. Subsequent N6.5 units must migrate tenant-owned consumers before final certification.
